summary.intent: Assess and close stale umbrella issues (#635, #991, #992) in the cipher-box GitHub repo, audit all open comp:engine issues for validity, then investigate whether the ADR decision corpus (in cipher-box-next) has kept pace with years of blueprint/CONTEXT.md changes before considering moving ADRs into the main repo, and finally draft/land the resulting retroactive ADRs and blueprint rewords.
summary.outcome: Closed #635/#991/#992 and filed follow-up issues; audited and updated 17 comp:engine issues; ran a multi-pass fresh-eyes investigation of a 314+ row commit-history/ADR-coverage audit; drafted, reviewed, and merged all 23 candidate ADRs (0029-0051) plus amendments to existing ADRs as draft PRs in cipher-box-next, all now merged and marked Accepted; applied ~230 blueprint/CONTEXT.md/AGENTS.md rewording edits across 9 files citing the new ADRs, lint-clean, with a docs PR in progress and several follow-up defects filed as new cipher-box issues.

repo: cipher-box's tracker-refs lint gate exempts bare 1-2 digit #NN issue references in blueprint text (assumed to only name cipher-box-next), which breaks if a citation number grows past 2 digits or references a cipher-box issue instead
comp:engine issue audits must re-check against origin/main HEAD because PRs merge mid-audit (PR #1989 shifted the head during the first audit pass)

Agent-authored GitHub comments/issue bodies posted under the owner's account (FSM1) are not proof of an owner decision — only an explicit in-session record (confirmed by orchestrator memory) counts, per the user's ruling

map #813 resolution comments (cb#818, #820, #825, #830, #841, #844) all use one shared agent template with no owner endorsement in-thread, but the user ruled that these are still owner decisions since he personally approved that resolution comment
cipher-box-next has no CI or lint config, so ADR PRs there only need markdownlint clean, no test gate
Worktrees created without running install lack node_modules, so pre-commit hooks (lint-staged) fail; lint by hand (prettier + markdownlint via stdin) and commit --no-verify
markdownlint refuses to lint files outside the repo path — pipe file content via --stdin --config .markdownlint.json instead
1Password commit signing can fail in a freshly cloned checkout; commit.gpgsign=false must be set locally in that clone (as already done for the main repo)

code.finding: publish_record unconditionally uploads every record head block to the hosted API regardless of placement mode, causing a lockout for External-placement (BYO) accounts once byo=true is set (issue #2006, later re-decided so heads follow placement)
API throws ConflictException for any hosted upload when user.byo is true, with no exemption for record head blocks — root cause of the #2006 External-mode lockout
reseal_scope_root refuses (CarriedWriteHistoryLinkTooLarge) an over-length carried write-history link instead of dropping it as blueprint/core.md 'Write-body' claims (ADR 0033 E1 residual)
MAX_RETAINED_HISTORY_LINK_BYTES = 256 caps retained history links; not previously stated anywhere in the blueprint (ADR 0033 E6)

workflow: Splitting a large validity/history audit across multiple parallel sub-agents grouped by file/area works well, but nested sub-agents' completion results route to the top-level orchestrator instead of their direct parent agent — must forward via SendMessage

A batch pipeline of writer→independent reviewer→apply-fixes→open-PR per artifact (used for all 23 ADRs) scales well but needs the orchestrator to track many concurrent task IDs and dispatch reviews/writers incrementally as slots free up

When conflicting findings arise from parallel auditors, running one more targeted 'fresh eyes' challenge investigation pass per disputed item is an effective way to resolve disagreements before finalizing a summary document

For visual/diagrammatic explanations of technical tradeoffs (e.g. architecture options), the archify skill can generate delivered interactive HTML diagrams with browser-verified screenshots to support ELI5-style explanations

When the user pushes back with a valid architectural objection (e.g. 'CipherBox infra on the critical path'), re-verify assumptions with a fresh grep/trace pass rather than defending the original recommendation — it reversed the recommendation from Option A to Option B in this session

friction: Repeated iteration cycles where new PRs from other lanes (PR #1989) or draft PRs from parallel teams (PR #1999) shifted the ground truth mid-audit, forcing re-verification against the latest origin/main
GitHub API/GraphQL rate limits were hit while opening many ADR draft PRs in quick succession, requiring a wait and a switch of the PR-opening script from GraphQL to REST

The PR-decided ownership bar was inconsistent across the four initial audit sub-agents (one required explicit 'Decision' comments, others accepted issue bodies), requiring a whole extra re-rating pass over 21+46 sources
Nested agent handing off to its own sub-agents caused stalls where the parent reported 'still running' with no progress, requiring a SendMessage nudge to resume it
One agent's cleanup command (`rm *.orig.md` glob) risked deleting sibling agents' backup files in a shared scratch directory (turned out harmless since GitHub retains edit history)
open_items: 13 amend targets from the audit (ADR files 0006, 0007, 0009, 0010, 0022, 0023 + 7 wayfinder thread decision sets) still need amendment PRs in cipher-box-next
Small chore PR still needed for code/workflow comment citation fixes (crates/engine various files, .github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml) collected during the reword pass

Draft PR #1999 (fixes #1992/#1995) has a known acceptance gap on the third acceptance item — row a write wave re-mints as an owner-signed placeholder is out of reach of the revoke fallback; must be checked before merge

Several ADR review-flagged 'owner must decide' items remain open in already-merged ADRs: #108 ADR 0047 E1 dead-letter abandonment exits classification, #100 ADR 0048 E6 conversion-entry-before-ack vs ADR 0023 D5 conflict, #104 ADR 0043 E2 cross-scope restore dead-letter vs re-seal promise, #107 ADR 0050 E7 nightly-only liveness suite gating

Newly filed defect issues (#2008 malformed contentCid panic, #2009 raw recipient subkey in revocation floor record, #2013–#2021 covering rename/move stamp mismatch, two-leg move parking, Windows GPLv3 notice, cut-floor read gaps, desktop forced-pass gaps, register batch body-size cap, observed-unlink data loss, cross-scope restore dead-letter, and registry row leak on dead-letter/trim/refusal) all remain unimplemented, tracked under #1702/#1262

The ADR-repo-move to a single repo (cipher-box) is still blocked pending resolution of the 13 amend targets, per the user's explicit ordering ('all this churn should be resolved before the move to 1 repo')

Reword docs PR (9 files: AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, blueprint/{api,core,deploy,desktop,engine,testing,web-client}.md) was mid-flight — final lint fixes applied but PR not yet committed/opened at end of transcript
